proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.sourceFilter
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants advantage only on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, not on all saving throws.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.attackKindFilter
proposed_widenings.justification: The item imposes disadvantage only on spell attack rolls against the bearer, not on all attack rolls.
proposed_widenings.evidence: spell attack rolls have Disadvantage against you

notes: Fits existing magic_item + passive family structurally, but current roll-modifier filters cannot represent magical-source saving throws or spell-attack-only disadvantage without over-applying the effect. No content/tracer files were authored.
